name: Zhang Zhixia
affiliation: Peking University · Incoming Ph.D. Student · Fall 2027
intro: I am an undergraduate student in Computer Science and Technology at Beihang University. I will begin a direct-entry Ph.D. at Peking University in Fall 2027, advised by Prof. Ling Yang.
experience: I am a research intern in Prof. Dianbo Liu’s group at the National University of Singapore (July–October 2026). I previously held research internships with Profs. Xianglong Liu and Yikun Ban.
research: My research interests lie in reinforcement learning, large language models, and AI agents. My long-term goal is to build agent systems that can autonomously evolve, learn from experience, and reliably carry out long-horizon tasks. I am particularly interested in the learning mechanisms that make these capabilities possible and in exploring their applications to real-world problems.
